name: install
description: Install this toolbox to a target prefix — copies the lean runtime payload (tools/, lib/, lockfiles, docs; no tests or git history), syncs Python/Node deps, and generates a bin/ape dispatcher shim. Wraps the repo-root install.sh, which also supports curl-pipe bootstrap on a bare machine.
use_when: installing or updating the toolbox at a prefix, or bootstrapping it elsewhere

args.name: --prefix
args.description: Target directory. Omit for in-place setup of the current tree.

args.name: --tools
args.description: Comma-separated subset; ape/list-tools/tool-search are always included.

args.name: --update
args.description: Replace the managed payload at an existing prefix.

args.name: --no-deps / --no-node
args.description: Skip uv sync and/or npm ci.

args.name: --obscura
args.description: Download the Obscura browser binary into vendor/.

args.name: --with-tests
args.description: Include tests/ in a copy-install (excluded by default).

env.APE_TOOLS_REPO: Git URL fetched when install.sh runs piped/standalone.

stdout: JSON summary: {installed, tools, bin, state}. Progress goes to stderr.
notes: Only installer-managed paths are replaced on --update; state lives under AGENT_TOOLS_HOME and is untouched.
